verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents risk rules, case management, A/B risk experiments, backtesting and a Disputes API for retrieving and defending disputes. None of it describes a reporting view of dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload, or a way to export those metrics. The Disputes API and risk experiments are at most building blocks or adjacent features, not the metrics-and-export capability itself.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board
